audio_caption: The audio begins with a male speaker introducing himself and the topic of an Adobe Illustrator tutorial about coloring. He states, "I'm a hurry up and get to it because I ain't going to be making a video like most people." He expresses a desire to avoid wasting time, emphasizing, "We finna jump right into it." The speaker then transitions to the tutorial's content.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker declaring he's going to draw a "simple picture," while simultaneously stating it will be "dope" because he is naturally so. The speech is followed by music, categorized as hip-hop, with a chill mood and synth sounds. Following a pause in the music, the speaker expresses surprise ("What is that?"), followed by an exclamation of distress. Another male speaker then describes a freezer, acknowledging its less-than-ideal appearance, but clarifying it is for a "how-to color tutorial." The speaker then resumes providing instruction, advising listeners to select everything and then merge all lines together.

The audio clip starts with speech from a male speaker, providing instruction by mentioning "expand appearance," followed by "go to your Pathfinder," and then "click merge." His tone is instructive and calm. Subsequently, he confirms with "Now, we made every line I drew; we made it one," ending with a rhetorical question, "You know what I'm saying?" This is then followed by a brief musical interlude with a discernible Hip Hop influence, establishing a relaxed mood.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker describing a layering process, using phrases like "grab my layer," "blank sheet of paper," and "lock the top layer," suggesting an artistic or technical context. He explains the reason for locking the top layer is to keep the line work on top when adding shadows. This portion is delivered in a casual, explanatory tone. An electronic music sting then plays with a slightly unsettling mood. Afterwards, the speaker continues with instructions, emphasizing the importance of highlighting the second layer.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker mentioning picking a color to "start out with" and decides on a "goldish yellow". He then instructs the listener to click the rectangle tool and drag it over the line work. Then, he moves on to the next step: "get your pointer tool" and click the color over the line work.

The audio clip starts with a male speaker explaining how to right-click something, saying "You going right-click it," followed by instructions to "arrange and send to the back." The background contains speech.

The audio begins with a male speaker describing how to highlight everything together and then merge it into one, speaking in a calm and instructive tone. Background music plays during this speech, in the style of mellow hip-hop, creating a laid-back mood.

The audio clip features a male speaker giving instructions, possibly in a tutorial context, as he mentions, "After you re-merge it, click off of it, regular click onto it, then right click onto it." He speaks in an instructional tone, advising how to "isolate selected group." He emphasizes the importance of having everything closed off when doing line work. There is background music, identifiable as trap, which creates a moody atmosphere. Towards the end, the speaker references deleting an outer color, suggesting an action being performed in the tutorial.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker stating, "Okay, now we fixing to color the eyes," and outlines the steps involved, instructing the listener to "click one eye," then to "hold shift and click the other one," in order to select both at once. The speaker continues to describe navigating to the color selection tool and choosing the desired eye color, concluding by saying, "click okay." The tone is instructional and calm.

The audio begins with a distinct, repetitive, and somewhat eerie hip-hop beat featuring synths and a dark mood. A male voice then interjects, providing art instructions with a casual tone, including directions to "make his eyes red," and "this thing purple." He then continues giving instructions related to layers. The music continues in the background, creating a slightly unsettling atmosphere along with the technical instructions.

The audio clip starts with a male speaker describing that they're "gonna add one more layer for highlights", saying that'll be "all she wrote". Following this, music begins. It's an instrumental hip-hop beat that sounds relaxed. After a while, the male speaker returns saying "and there you have it, how to color in adobe illustrator". He then thanks the listeners for watching, adding "more heat coming soon, stay tuned".
